title_as_printed: Bubble point data of the system CO2 + H2O.

footnotes_as_printed.u: Standard uncertainties u are u(T) = 0.15 K, u(x) = 0.0002 and u(p) = 0.004 MPa.

pressure_note: bubble-point pressure (synthetic method: pressure at which the last CO2 bubble disappears at fixed T and fixed overall composition); transducer in cell; absolute/gauge not stated
notes: x_CO2 is the prepared overall CO2 mole fraction of the known-composition mixture, equal to the liquid composition at the bubble point. Printed as four side-by-side blocks (x = 0.003-0.010 and 0.012-0.020) with x printed once per block; stacked here with x repeated on every row. Isotherms 283-363 K. No hydrate region stated.
